args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy made checkout-api unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: service is now healthy in all regions with error rate ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in production; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified healthy: error rate dropped from 18% to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback — the on-call engineer has been paged.
